webhook.deliveries.title: Deliveries
webhook.settings.webhookMaxAttempts.desc: How many attempts a delivery gets, the first one included, before it is dead-lettered. 1 to 10.
webhook.settings.webhookRetryDelaysMs.de: The wait before retry 1, 2, 3… in milliseconds, comma-separated (up to 9 values, each 1000 to 86400000). A retry past the list waits the last value. Default: 60000,300000,900000
webhook.settings.webhookRequestTimeoutMs: Per-request timeout for a webhook delivery, in milliseconds. 1000 to 120000.
webhook.settings.webhookCircuitBreakerTh: Auto-disable an endpoint after this many consecutive failed deliveries (1 to 100000). A success resets the counter; test sends do not count.
webhook.settings.webhookDefaultRateLimit: Fallback per-endpoint delivery rate limit when a webhook has none set. Leave blank or enter 0 for unlimited.
